title: Xbox returns to where it all began for its 25th anniversary
summary: Seattle, we’re coming home. XBOX FanFest is coming on Thursday, November 12, 2026 - find out what to expect and how to attend inside.
body_markdown:
Seattle, we’re coming home. XBOX FanFest arrives at the Museum of Pop Culture (MoPOP) on Thursday, November 12, 2026, for the final stop of this year’s eight-city FanFest Tour. As we get ready to celebrate 25 years of XBOX on November 15, we’re bringing fans together in the city where it all began for a special anniversary week celebration to celebrate the games, people and memories that have shaped 25 years of XBOX


When we announced this year’s FanFest Tour, we wanted to celebrate the people who make XBOX what it is: **you** .


25 years of XBOX is a story we share with you. Thank you for the friendships, the enthusiasm, and the joy you bring to play. We can’t wait to mark this milestone together.


Fans joining us at MoPOP can expect a celebration of XBOX past, present and future, with hands on gameplay, XBOX history and artifacts, opportunities to connect with the people behind the games and fellow players, XBOX trivia, collectibles. fan activities, an XBOX Gear pop-up shop and plenty of surprises along the way.


### **Want to join us in Seattle?**


We’re giving fans the chance to win their way into XBOX FanFest Seattle through the **XBOX FanFest Seattle Ticket Sweepstakes** . Winners will be selected at random and notified by email. Entrants and attendees must be 18 or older, and travel and lodging are not included.


[Enter the XBOX FanFest Ticket Sweepstakes here.](https://aka.ms/XBOXFanFestSeattleEnter)


**NO PURCHASE NECESSARY.** Open to eligible U.S. residents 18+. Void where prohibited.[See Official Rules](https://aka.ms/XBOXFanFestSeattleRules) for eligibility, prize details, restrictions and terms. **Ends October 11, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. PT.**


### **Be our guest!**


No matter where in the world you play, we want to give a lucky fan a special way to be a part of our final stop on the FanFest Tour. Enter the **XBOX FanFest Green Ticket Trip Sweepstakes for a chance to win a trip for you and a friend to join us in Seattle and celebrate 25 years of XBOX together.**


[Enter the Green Ticket Trip Sweepstakes here.](https://aka.ms/XBOXFanFestGreenTicketEnter)


**NO PURCHASE NECESSARY.** Open to eligible residents 18+. One (1) Grand Prize consisting of a trip for winner + one (1) guest to XBOX FanFest Seattle. Void where prohibited.[See Official Rules](https://aka.ms/XBOXFanFestGreenTicketRules) for eligibility, prize details, restrictions and terms. **Ends October 11, 2026, at 11:59pm PT.**


You can find more information about XBOX FanFest[here](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/community/fanfest) . Whether you’re hoping to join us in Seattle or celebrating with your community elsewhere, visit the[XBOX 25th anniversary hub](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-25th-anniversary) to explore the wider celebration.
